ja422:1.1: Dhammo have hato hanti, nāhato hanti kañcinaṃ, tasmā hi dhammaṃ na hane mā taṃ dhammo hato hanīti.
ja422:2.1: Alikaṃ bhāsamānassa apakkamanti devatā, pūtikañ ca mukhaṃ vāti saggaṭṭhānā ca dhaṃsati yo jānaṃ pucchiro pañhaṃ aññathā naṃ viyākare ti.
ja422:3.1: Sace hi saccaṃ bhaṇasi hohi rāja yathā pure, musā ce bhāsase rāja bhūmiyaṃ tiṭṭha Cetiyā 'ti.
ja422:4.1: Akāle vassatī tassa kāle tassa na vassati yo jānaṃ pucchito pañhaṃ aññathā naṃ viyākare ti.
ja422:5.1: Sace hi saccaṃ bhaṇasi hohi rāja yathā pure, musā ce bhāsase rāja bhūmiṃ pavisa Cetiyā 'ti.
ja422:6.1: Jivhā tassa dvidhā hoti uragasseva disampati yo jānaṃ pucchito pañhaṃ aññathā naṃ viyākare.
ja422:7.1: Sace hi saccaṃ bhaṇasi hohi rāja yathā pure, musā ce bhāsase rāja bhiyyo pavisa Cetiyā 'ti
ja422:8.1: Jivhā tassa na bhavati macchasseva disampati yo jānaṃ pucchito pañhaṃ aññathā naṃ viyākare.
ja422:9.1: Sace hi saccaṃ bhaṇasi hohi rāja yathā pure, musā ce bhāsase rāja bhiyyo pavisa Cetiyā
ja422:10.1: 'ti. Thiyo tassa pajāyanti na pumā jāyare kule yo jānaṃ pucchito pañhaṃ aññathā naṃ viyākare.
ja422:11.1: Sace hi saccaṃ bhaṇasi hohi rāja yathā pure, musā ce bhāsase rāja bhiyyo pavisa Cetiyā 'ti.
ja422:12.1: Puttā tassa na bhavanti pakkamanti disodisaṃ yo jānaṃ pucchito pañhaṃ aññathā naṃ viyākare.
ja422:13.1: Sace hi saccaṃ bhaṇasi hohi rāja yathā pure, musā ce bhāsase rāja bhiyyo pavisa Cetiyā 'ti.
ja422:14.1: Sa rājā isinā satto antalikkhecaro pure pāvekkhi paṭhaviṃ c' eso hīnatto {patvā} pariyāyaṃ.
ja422:15.1: Tasmā hi chandāgamanaṃ na-ppasaṃsanti paṇḍitā, (= vol.II 172|20.) aduṭṭhacitto bhāseyya giraṃ saccūpasaṃhitan ti
